messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Tell your healthcare provider if you are pregnant, become pregnant, or plan to become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets. Using fluoxetine later in pregnancy may increase the risk of complications in the newborn, including problems that need a longer hospital stay, breathing support, or tube feeding, and a serious lung condition called persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN). Untreated depression also carries risks in pregnancy, so discuss the benefits and risks of treatment with your healthcare provider rather than stopping on your own.
If you become pregnant while taking fluoxetine tablets, ask your healthcare provider about joining the National Pregnancy Registry for Antidepressants, which tracks pregnancy outcomes in women who take these medicines. You can enroll by calling 1-866-961-2388 or visiting womensmentalhealth.org.

B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
